==About==

An {{i|Autumn Gold}} is the product of a second growth stage, first tier {{i|Pumpkin}} Harvest. Right-clicking an Autumn Gold and selecting "Slice" will give you 4x {{i|Pumpkin Flesh}} and 10x {{i|Seeds of Pumpkin}}. An Autumn Gold can be stored in a {{i|Stockbin}}.
